note: I028: how far a harbour is from onward travel, for agreeing another harbour with a passenger. Honest bands, never a precise time: the game does not simulate taxis, trains or flights. A harbour listed here has a curated band; any other gets an estimate from the catalogue (a major harbour: an airport within the hour; a regional harbour: one to three hours; a small harbour: three hours or more; an island: a ferry first) and is shown as an estimate.
